summary_bullets: Remove the suppressed merge parity Makefile target so shard CI no longer depends on a redundant pytest guard.
Keep the linting catalog aligned with Makefile coverage and point parity coverage at the Python test job.
Document the /report-tokens scan-input trust boundary and the Python egress redaction path.
commit_message:
Remove redundant merge parity harness target

Remove test-merge-parity from the Makefile shard wiring now that the Python parity test runs under make py-test. Update the linting catalog and document /report-tokens scan-input trust boundaries plus the Python egress redactor in SECURITY.md.
